name: Routine Operations (Variable Conditions)
description: Simulates routine operation with clean-to-moderate air quality and dynamically changing user demand.

name: High Demand (Computational Uncertainty)
description: Introduces computational-complexity peaks for which the system determines whether hybrid quantum-classical execution is warranted.

name: Environmental Crisis
description: Represents hazardous air quality that requires the system to enforce restrictions despite conflicting user preferences.

name: Infrastructure Degradation
description: Models unstable cloud infrastructure with queue times ranging from responsive to saturated, requiring adaptive backend selection.
